instruction: Can you disable the 'Use only one instance when started from file manager' option in VLC? I want to be able to open multiple VLC windows simultaneously.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the one-instance mode in VLC. The evaluator checks if one-instance-when-started-from-file is set to 0 (disabled) in the VLC configuration file. Similar configuration task requiring VLC interface settings navigation.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric function. Expected value: one-instance-when-started-from-file=0 in vlcrc.
